title: Microsoft Teams: change the background while recording a video clip on iPhone
summary: Hold: the briefing reports licensing as unpublished even though the cited Teams service description documents the product's licensing and mobile-client entitlement. State that baseline requirement and limit the uncertainty to any requirement specific to this background option. The roadmap facts, messaging-policy path and PowerShell control are supported.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The licensing model is unknown because a licence covering this Teams feature is not yet published.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams can be licensed as part of qualifying Microsoft 365 offerings or as a standalone SKU. / All supported subscription plans are eligible for access to the Teams web client, desktop clients, and mobile apps.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included. Replace the licensing notes and the broad unpublished-licence statements with: 'Microsoft Teams can be licensed as part of qualifying Microsoft 365 offerings or as a standalone SKU; all supported subscription plans provide access to Teams mobile apps. Microsoft has not published a licensing requirement specific to changing the background while recording a clip.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/office365/servicedescriptions/teams-service-description. Narrow the licensing open question to 'Does Microsoft publish any licensing requirement specific to this background option?' Keep the cost rationale's uncertainty limited to feature-specific licensing and metering.
